packageRules.description: onnxruntime / onnxruntime-node are pinned at 1.29.0: >=1.30 segfaults loading the vendored maia3_simplified.onnx (exit 139, reproduced 2026-10-09 on 1.30.0 and 1.31.0). A bump must pass the Phase 218 parity spike (scripts/maia_parity_spike.py, verify_value_head.mjs) first.

js-yaml and fast-uri exist only as npm overrides pinning patched transitive versions. A major would force the next major onto consumers that declare ^4 / ^3 (cosmiconfig, ajv@8), so disable majors; minor and patch floors still flow through the grouped branch.
